name: Han Sui
source:
Sue works in the department of psychiatry in an university affiliated hospital and she is the personal physician of Joe. She was transferred here a year ago. 

She is an attractive and elegant woman that anyone will notice without even looking closely. Everyone has his vices and hers is moderate OCD, for which she is sometimes mistaken as the patient by new colleagues.
